contexts.none: No unit selected — show prompt text only
contexts.factory: Show a random T1 factory from the selected faction(s)
contexts.builder: Show a random constructor/builder from the selected faction(s)
contexts.rezbot: Show a resurrection bot from the selected faction(s)
contexts.transport: Show a transport plane from the selected faction(s)
contexts.area-artillery: A supported artillery unit: Armada Mauser, Cortex Quaker or Legion Cleaver.

shortcuts.label: Select
shortcuts.description: Left-click a unit — selects just that one, replacing the current selection

shortcuts.label: Double-click: Same Type on Screen
shortcuts.description: Double-click a unit to select all units of that type on screen.

shortcuts.label: Double-click: Same Type Anywhere
shortcuts.description: Hold Ctrl and double-click a unit to select its type across the map.

shortcuts.label: Select: Add
shortcuts.description: Hold Shift and left-click a unit to add it to the selection.

shortcuts.label: Select: Toggle
shortcuts.description: Hold Ctrl and left-click a unit to add or remove it from the selection.

shortcuts.label: Deselect All
shortcuts.description: Clear the selection.

shortcuts.label: Box Select
shortcuts.description: Drag a box to select units. Higher-priority units take precedence: combat units before constructors and resurrection bots, those before buildings.

shortcuts.label: Box Select: Add
shortcuts.description: Hold Shift while dragging a box to add its units and buildings to the selection.

shortcuts.label: Box Select: Remove
shortcuts.description: Hold Ctrl while dragging the box — the units inside are taken out of the current selection

shortcuts.label: Box Select: Mobile Only
shortcuts.description: Hold Alt while dragging a box to select mobile combat units.

shortcuts.label: Box Select: Matching Unit Types
shortcuts.description: Hold the key and drag a box to select units matching the types already selected.

shortcuts.label: Box Select: Idle Units Only
shortcuts.description: Hold Space while dragging the box — only units with nothing to do are picked up

shortcuts.label: Select and Go to Commander
shortcuts.description: Jump to and select your commander

shortcuts.label: Select All Units
shortcuts.description: Select all of your units across the map.

shortcuts.label: Cycle Idle Constructors
shortcuts.description: Select the next idle construction unit

shortcuts.label: Select All of Same Type
shortcuts.description: Select your units across the map whose types match the current selection.

shortcuts.label: Select Same Type on Screen
shortcuts.description: Select your visible units whose types match the current selection.

shortcuts.label: Select Damaged Units
shortcuts.description: Keep selected non-building units below 60% health.

shortcuts.label: Split Army
shortcuts.description: Select half of the current selection to divide your army into two groups.

shortcuts.label: Select Waiting Units on Screen
shortcuts.description: Select your visible units with a Wait order.

shortcuts.label: Select All Idle Transports
shortcuts.description: Select your idle transport units across the map.

shortcuts.label: Add Commander to Selection
shortcuts.description: Add the commander to the current selection.

shortcuts.label: Cycle Selection Backwards
shortcuts.description: Cycle backwards through the selected units.

shortcuts.label: Move
shortcuts.description: Right-click the ground to move there.

shortcuts.label: Set Target / Attack
shortcuts.description: Right-click an enemy to attack it. In settings, you can change this to Set Target.

shortcuts.label: Reclaim
shortcuts.description: With a constructor selected, right-click a wreck to reclaim it for metal.

shortcuts.label: Resurrect
shortcuts.description: With a resurrection bot selected, right-click a wreck to resurrect it.

shortcuts.label: Repair
shortcuts.description: With a repair-capable unit selected, right-click a damaged friendly to repair it.

shortcuts.label: Guard
shortcuts.description: Right-click a friendly unit to guard it.

shortcuts.label: Build / Upgrade Mex or Geo
shortcuts.description: Right-click a metal spot or geothermal vent to build the extractor there — right-click your own T1 extractor to upgrade it to T2

shortcuts.label: Move & Assume Formation
shortcuts.description: Hold Alt and right-click a destination to move into formation.

shortcuts.label: Move in Formation
shortcuts.description: Hold Ctrl and right-click a destination to move while retaining the unit formation.

shortcuts.label: Queue
shortcuts.description: Choose the command, then hold Shift while clicking or dragging its target to append the order.

shortcuts.label: Execute Immediately
shortcuts.description: Choose the command, then hold Space while clicking or dragging its target to execute it immediately and resume the previous queue afterwards.

details.title: Enemy reclaim
details.text: Press E, then hold Space and drag a circle from ground or a unit to reclaim enemies, replacing the queue. Hold Shift as well to append.

shortcuts.label: Insert Into Route
shortcuts.description: Choose the command, then hold Shift+Space while clicking or dragging its target to insert it where it adds the least travel.

details.title: Build Split
details.text: With two or more units selected, building orders are split among builders.

details.title: Patrol, Restore and enemy reclaim
details.text: These orders append to the queue.

shortcuts.label: Skip Current Command
shortcuts.description: Move on to the next order.

shortcuts.label: Cancel Last Command
shortcuts.description: Remove the last order from the queue.

shortcuts.label: Move Queued Waypoint
shortcuts.description: Hold Shift and left-drag an existing queued waypoint to move it.

details.title: Supported orders
details.text: Move, Fight, Patrol, ground attacks and area orders for Attack, Reclaim, Repair, Resurrect, Load, Unload and Restore. Excludes build orders and attacks on individual units.

shortcuts.label: Copy Queued Waypoint
shortcuts.description: Hold Shift+Alt and left-drag an existing queued waypoint to copy it.

details.title: Supported orders
details.text: Move, Fight, Patrol, ground attacks and area orders for Attack, Reclaim, Repair, Resurrect, Load, Unload and Restore. Excludes build orders and attacks on individual units.

shortcuts.label: Attack
shortcuts.description: Press A, then left-click an enemy to attack it.

shortcuts.label: Attack Circle
shortcuts.description: Press A, then left-drag a circle to attack enemies inside it.

details.title: Space
details.text: Press A, then hold Space and left-drag a circle: this can insert a ground attack at the circle’s center.

shortcuts.label: Attack Line
shortcuts.description: Press A, then right-drag to attack ground positions along a line.

shortcuts.label: Area Attack
shortcuts.description: Press Ctrl+A, release the keys, then left-drag a circle to area attack.
shortcuts.prerequisite: Select a supported unit, for example Mauser or Stormbringer.

details.title: Armada: Artillery
details.text: Shellshocker, Basilica, Mauser.

details.title: Armada: Armed aircraft
details.text: Falcon, Highwind, Cormorant, Liche, Blizzard, Tsunami, Cyclone, Stiletto, Stormbringer.

details.title: Armada: Unarmed aircraft
details.text: Oracle, Blink, Horizon.

details.title: Cortex: Artillery
details.text: Basilisk, Quaker, Wolverine.

details.title: Cortex: Armed aircraft
details.text: Hailstorm, Dam Buster, Bat, Whirlwind, Angler, Nighthawk, Valiant.

details.title: Cortex: Unarmed aircraft
details.text: Condor, Finch, Watcher.

details.title: Legion: Artillery
details.text: Cleaver, Olympus.

details.title: Legion: Armed aircraft
details.text: Ajax, Aesacus, Blindfold, Noctua, Martyr, Harbinger, Phoenix, Pyrphoros, Astrapios, Venator.

details.title: Legion: Unarmed aircraft
details.text: Okeanos, Whisper.

details.title: Notably not supported: Armada — artillery, rockets and heavy weapons
details.text: Gauntlet, Rattlesnake, Ragnarok, Pulsar, Starlight, Ambassador, Paralyzer, Janus, Possum, Rocketeer, Recluse, Vanguard, Fatboy, Dreadnought, Longbow.

details.title: Notably not supported: Cortex — artillery and rockets
details.text: Agitator, Persecutor, Cerberus, Calamity, Tremor, Negotiator, Arbiter, Catapult, Banisher, Mangonel, Aggravator, Catalyst, Despot, Messenger.

details.title: Notably not supported: Legion — artillery and rockets
details.text: Amputator, Eviscerator, Barrage, Inferno, Boreas, Ballista, Thanatos, Medusa, Salacia, Astraeus, Starfall, Octeres, Corinth, Scylla, Ultor.

details.title: Notably not supported: Gunships
details.text: Banshee, Roughneck, Hornet, Sabre, Puffin, Wasp, Cutlass, Monsoon, Mosquito, Enyo, Ladon, Stronghold.

shortcuts.label: Remove Attack Orders in Area
shortcuts.description: Press A, then hold Ctrl and left-drag a circle from ground or an enemy to remove queued attacks in that area.

shortcuts.label: Attack Area by Type
shortcuts.description: Press A, then hold Alt and left-drag a circle from an enemy to attack enemies of that exact unit type, nearest first.

shortcuts.label: Split Attack
shortcuts.description: Press A, then hold Ctrl+Shift+Space and left-drag a circle from an enemy. Distribute enemy targets among selected units and append the orders.

shortcuts.label: Split Attack by Type
shortcuts.description: Press A, then hold Alt+Shift+Space and left-drag a circle from an enemy. Distribute targets of that exact type among selected units and append the orders.

shortcuts.label: Set Target
shortcuts.description: Press S, then left-click an enemy to set its priority target.

shortcuts.label: Set Target Area
shortcuts.description: Press S, then left-drag a circle to set priority targets in the area.

shortcuts.label: Set Target Area by Type
shortcuts.description: Press S, then hold Alt and left-drag a circle from an enemy to set targets on only enemies of that unit type inside it

shortcuts.label: Set Target (Sticky)
shortcuts.description: Press S, then hold Ctrl and left-click an enemy to keep its priority target after Stop.

shortcuts.label: Set Target Area (Sticky)
shortcuts.description: Press S, then hold Ctrl and left-drag a target circle to keep its priority targets after Stop.

shortcuts.label: Split Set Target
shortcuts.description: Press S, then hold Ctrl, Shift and Space and left-drag a circle from an enemy to hand each selected unit its own share of the enemies inside as targets

details.title: Stop
details.text: These priority targets survive Stop. Use Clear Target to remove them.

shortcuts.label: Split Set Target by Type
shortcuts.description: Press S, then hold Alt, Shift and Space and left-drag a circle from an enemy to hand each selected unit its own share of the enemies of that unit type inside as targets

shortcuts.label: Clear Target
shortcuts.description: Clear the preferred fire target

shortcuts.label: Set Target: No Ground
shortcuts.description: Press Alt+S, then left-click an enemy unit or structure to set its priority target.

shortcuts.label: Fight
shortcuts.description: Press F, then left-click a destination to advance while engaging enemies in range.

shortcuts.label: Fight Line
shortcuts.description: Press F, then left-drag to spread units along a line.

shortcuts.label: Fight Path
shortcuts.description: Press F, then right-drag. Multiple units spread along the line; one unit follows a path.

shortcuts.label: Patrol
shortcuts.description: Press H, then left-click patrol destinations to make a looping route.

shortcuts.label: Guard
shortcuts.description: Press O, then left-click a friendly unit to guard it.

shortcuts.label: Repeat
shortcuts.description: Repeat currently queued orders

shortcuts.label: Stop
shortcuts.description: Stop the unit and clear its order queue.

details.title: Sticky targets
details.text: Targets set by pressing S, then holding Ctrl while clicking or dragging survive Stop. Use Clear Target to remove them.

shortcuts.label: Wait
shortcuts.description: Pause the unit until further orders — one press flips it back on

shortcuts.label: Gather Wait
shortcuts.description: Wait until the selected units reach this point in their queues, then continue together.

shortcuts.label: On / Off
shortcuts.description: Activate shields, cloak fields and the like

shortcuts.label: Trajectory
shortcuts.description: How artillery and ballistic units arc their shots

shortcuts.label: Fire Stance
shortcuts.description: How units decide when to shoot

shortcuts.label: Move Stance
shortcuts.description: How far units stray from where you put them

shortcuts.label: Cloak
shortcuts.description: Toggle cloaking.

shortcuts.label: Manual Fire
shortcuts.description: Press D, then left-click a target to fire the unit’s special weapon, such as a D-Gun or EMP missile.

shortcuts.label: Capture
shortcuts.description: Press W, then left-click an enemy unit or structure to capture it.

shortcuts.label: Capture Area
shortcuts.description: Press W, then left-drag a circle to capture enemies inside it.

shortcuts.label: Capture Area by Type
shortcuts.description: Press W, then hold Alt and left-drag a circle from an enemy to capture only enemies of that unit type inside it

shortcuts.label: Self-Destruct
shortcuts.description: Order the unit to self-destruct

shortcuts.label: Show Explosion Radius
shortcuts.description: Hold Space+X to preview the explosion radius.

shortcuts.label: Queue Wait
shortcuts.description: Pause after completing the preceding orders.

shortcuts.label: Queue Self-Destruct
shortcuts.description: Self-destruct after completing the preceding orders.

shortcuts.label: Save Unit-State Default
shortcuts.description: Hold Ctrl and left-click a unit-state button to save its state for newly produced units of that type.

shortcuts.label: Clear Unit-State Default
shortcuts.description: Hold Alt and left-click a unit-state button to remove its saved default.

shortcuts.label: Cycle Unit State Backwards
shortcuts.description: Right-click a unit-state button to cycle in the opposite direction to left-click.

shortcuts.label: Reclaim
shortcuts.description: Press E, then left-click a unit, wreck or feature to reclaim it for metal or energy.

shortcuts.label: Reclaim Area
shortcuts.description: Press E, then left-drag a circle from bare ground to reclaim wrecks and features inside it.

shortcuts.label: Reclaim Area: Metal Only
shortcuts.description: Press E, then left-drag a circle from a wreck or metal rock to reclaim metal sources inside it.

shortcuts.label: Reclaim Area: Energy Only
shortcuts.description: Press E, then left-drag a circle from a tree to reclaim energy sources inside it.

shortcuts.label: Reclaim Area by Type
shortcuts.description: Press E, then hold Alt and left-drag a circle from a unit or wreck to reclaim only that type. Keeps waiting for matching targets when the area is empty.

shortcuts.label: Reclaim Area, Repeat
shortcuts.description: Press E, then hold Alt and left-drag a circle from bare ground to keep reclaiming resources in the area.

shortcuts.label: Reclaim Area, Metal First
shortcuts.description: Press E, then hold Ctrl and left-drag a circle from bare ground to reclaim every metal source first and only then the energy sources

shortcuts.label: Reclaim Area by Team
shortcuts.description: Press E, then hold Ctrl and left-drag a circle from a unit. A friendly origin filters its team; an enemy origin includes enemy teams in the circle.

shortcuts.label: Reclaim Area by Tech Level
shortcuts.description: Press E, then hold Ctrl and left-drag a circle from a wreck to reclaim only wrecks whose unit has the same tech level

shortcuts.label: Split Reclaim by Tech Level
shortcuts.description: Press E, then hold Ctrl, Shift and Space and left-drag a circle from a wreck to split the same-tech wrecks inside between the selected builders, each reclaiming its own share

shortcuts.label: Split Reclaim by Type
shortcuts.description: Press E, then hold Alt+Shift+Space and left-drag a circle from a unit or wreck to split targets of that type between builders.

shortcuts.label: Reclaim Enemies in Area
shortcuts.description: Press E, then hold Space and left-drag a circle from ground or a unit to reclaim enemies in the circle. This replaces the queue; hold Shift as well while dragging to append.

shortcuts.label: Repair
shortcuts.description: Press R, then left-click a friendly unit or structure to repair it.

shortcuts.label: Repair Area
shortcuts.description: Press R, then left-drag a circle from bare ground to repair damaged or unfinished friendlies, stationary targets first.

shortcuts.label: Repair Area by Type
shortcuts.description: Press R, then hold Alt and left-drag a circle from a unit to repair only units of exactly that type inside it. Keeps waiting for matching targets when the area is empty.

shortcuts.label: Repair Area, Repeat
shortcuts.description: Press R, then hold Alt and left-drag a circle from bare ground to keep repairing units in the area.

shortcuts.label: Repair Area by Team
shortcuts.description: Press R, then hold Ctrl and left-drag a circle from a unit to repair every unit of that team inside it

shortcuts.label: Split Repair
shortcuts.description: Press R, then hold Ctrl, Shift and Space and left-drag a circle from a unit to split the units of that team inside between the selected builders, each repairing its own share

shortcuts.label: Split Repair by Type
shortcuts.description: Press R, then hold Alt, Shift and Space and left-drag a circle from a unit to split only units of exactly that type inside between the selected builders, each repairing its own share

shortcuts.label: Repair Area incl. Reclaimed
shortcuts.description: Press R, then hold Ctrl and left-drag a circle from bare ground to include units currently being reclaimed.

shortcuts.label: Resurrect
shortcuts.description: Press W, then left-click a wreck to resurrect it.

shortcuts.label: Resurrect Area
shortcuts.description: Press W, then left-drag a circle from bare ground to resurrect wrecks, nearest first. Each unit is repaired before the next wreck; wrecks being reclaimed are skipped.

shortcuts.label: Resurrect Area by Type
shortcuts.description: Press W, then hold Alt and left-drag a circle from a wreck to raise only wrecks of exactly that unit type. Keeps waiting for matching targets when the area is empty.

shortcuts.label: Resurrect Area, Repeat
shortcuts.description: Press W, then hold Alt and left-drag a circle from bare ground to keep resurrecting wrecks in the area.

shortcuts.label: Resurrect Area by Tech Level
shortcuts.description: Press W, then hold Ctrl and left-drag a circle from a wreck to raise only wrecks whose unit has the same tech level

shortcuts.label: Split Resurrect by Tech Level
shortcuts.description: Press W, then hold Ctrl, Shift and Space and left-drag a circle from a wreck to split the same-tech wrecks inside between the selected builders, each resurrecting its own share

shortcuts.label: Split Resurrect by Type
shortcuts.description: Press W, then hold Alt, Shift and Space and left-drag a circle from a wreck to split only wrecks of exactly that unit type inside between the selected builders, each resurrecting its own share

shortcuts.label: Resurrect Area incl. Reclaimed
shortcuts.description: Press W, then hold Ctrl and left-drag a circle from bare ground to include wrecks currently being reclaimed.

shortcuts.label: Repair & Reclaim Move
shortcuts.description: Press F, then left-click a destination to repair friendlies and reclaim wrecks on the way. Full metal storage can pause automatic reclaim.

shortcuts.label: Repair & Reclaim Line
shortcuts.description: Press F, then right-drag to repair and reclaim along the route. Multiple bots spread along the line; one follows a path. Full metal storage can pause automatic reclaim.

shortcuts.label: Repair & Resurrect Line
shortcuts.description: Press F, then hold Alt and right-drag to spread resurrection bots along a line, resurrecting wrecks on the way.

shortcuts.label: Resurrect Along Fight Route
shortcuts.description: Press F, then hold Alt and left-click a destination to resurrect wrecks on the way.

shortcuts.label: Queue Enemy Area Reclaim
shortcuts.description: Press E, then hold Shift+Space and left-drag a circle from ground or a unit to queue enemy reclaim orders.

shortcuts.label: Build Line
shortcuts.description: Choose a building, then hold Shift and drag — one copy after another along the line

shortcuts.label: Build Grid
shortcuts.description: Choose a building, then hold Shift and Alt while dragging — the rectangle fills up with copies

shortcuts.label: Build Straight Line
shortcuts.description: Choose a building, then hold Ctrl+Shift while dragging to place buildings in an axis-aligned line.

shortcuts.label: Build Border
shortcuts.description: Choose a building, then hold Ctrl, Shift and Alt while dragging — only the edge of the rectangle is built, for walling something in

shortcuts.label: Build Ring
shortcuts.description: Choose a building, then hold Ctrl and Shift and click an existing or planned structure — copies ring it on every side

shortcuts.label: Rotate Building Left
shortcuts.description: Rotate the building placement preview counter-clockwise

shortcuts.label: Rotate Building Right
shortcuts.description: Rotate the building placement preview clockwise

shortcuts.label: Increase Build Spacing
shortcuts.description: Increase spacing when placing a line or grid of structures

shortcuts.label: Decrease Build Spacing
shortcuts.description: Decrease spacing when placing a line or grid of structures

shortcuts.label: Restore
shortcuts.description: Press M, then left-drag an area to restore its original terrain height.

shortcuts.label: Repair & Reclaim Move
shortcuts.description: Press F, then left-click a destination to repair friendlies and reclaim wrecks on the way. Full metal storage can pause automatic reclaim.

shortcuts.label: Repair & Reclaim Line
shortcuts.description: Press F, then right-drag to repair and reclaim along the route. Multiple constructors spread along the line; one follows a path. Full metal storage can pause automatic reclaim.

shortcuts.label: Area Mex
shortcuts.description: Press the Area Mex key sequence, then left-drag a circle to build on available metal spots.

shortcuts.label: Area Mex: Upgrade Own
shortcuts.description: Press the Area Mex key sequence, then hold Alt and left-drag a circle to upgrade your T1 metal extractors to T2.

shortcuts.label: Cycle Builder
shortcuts.description: With several builders or factories selected, step the build menu to the next one

shortcuts.label: Split Build Line
shortcuts.description: Choose a building, then hold Shift+Space and drag to divide a line of buildings among builders and append their orders.

details.title: Build order
details.text: Each builder starts its own section, then helps with the remaining buildings.

shortcuts.prerequisite: Building preview active; at least two units selected.

shortcuts.label: Split Build Grid
shortcuts.description: Choose a building, then hold Shift+Alt+Space and drag to divide a grid of buildings among builders and append their orders.

details.title: Build order
details.text: Each builder starts its own section, then helps with the remaining buildings.

shortcuts.prerequisite: Building preview active; at least two units selected.

shortcuts.label: Split Area Mex
shortcuts.description: Press the Area Mex key sequence, then hold Shift+Space and left-drag a circle. Selected builders take different spots first, then help with the remaining spots.

shortcuts.label: Build Spacing with Side Buttons
shortcuts.description: With a building preview, hold Shift and use the side mouse buttons to adjust spacing.

shortcuts.label: Save Blueprint
shortcuts.description: Save the selected buildings as a blueprint — it becomes the active one, ready to place

shortcuts.label: Place Blueprint
shortcuts.description: Press Alt+B, then left-click to place the blueprint’s buildings.

shortcuts.label: Split Place Blueprint
shortcuts.description: Press Alt+B, then release Alt, hold Shift+Space and left-click to split the blueprint’s buildings between selected builders.

shortcuts.label: Next Blueprint
shortcuts.description: Cycle to the next blueprint in your list

shortcuts.label: Previous Blueprint
shortcuts.description: Cycle to the previous blueprint in your list

shortcuts.label: Delete Blueprint
shortcuts.description: Discard the blueprint you are currently holding

shortcuts.label: Factory Guard
shortcuts.description: Whether newly built units stay and guard the factory

shortcuts.label: Show Build Queue
shortcuts.description: Hold Shift+Space to show the selected factory’s queue.

shortcuts.label: Factory Queue Mode
shortcuts.description: Switch between a production queue and target unit counts (quotas).

shortcuts.label: Show Factory Presets
shortcuts.description: Hold Space to show ten preset slots. Press a number or click a slot to load it.

details.title: Saved settings
details.text: Presets are kept per factory type between matches and include the queue, repeat state and quota settings.

shortcuts.label: Load Factory Preset 1
shortcuts.description: Load the factory's saved build queue 1
shortcuts.prerequisite: Exactly one factory selected; hold Space to display the preset slots.

shortcuts.label: Load Factory Preset 2
shortcuts.description: Load the factory's saved build queue 2
shortcuts.prerequisite: Exactly one factory selected; hold Space to display the preset slots.

shortcuts.label: Load Factory Preset 3
shortcuts.description: Load the factory's saved build queue 3
shortcuts.prerequisite: Exactly one factory selected; hold Space to display the preset slots.

shortcuts.label: Load Factory Preset
shortcuts.description: Press the number of a preset box to load that build queue back into the factory
shortcuts.prerequisite: Exactly one factory selected; hold Space to display the preset slots.

details.title: Saved settings
details.text: Presets are kept per factory type between matches and include the queue, repeat state and quota settings.

shortcuts.label: Save Factory Preset 1
shortcuts.description: Save the selected factory's current build queue as preset 1

details.title: Saved settings
details.text: Presets are kept per factory type between matches and include the queue, repeat state and quota settings.

details.title: Delete preset
details.text: Save an empty queue to clear the slot.

shortcuts.label: Save Factory Preset 2
shortcuts.description: Save the selected factory's current build queue as preset 2

details.title: Saved settings
details.text: Presets are kept per factory type between matches and include the queue, repeat state and quota settings.

details.title: Delete preset
details.text: Save an empty queue to clear the slot.

shortcuts.label: Save Factory Preset 3
shortcuts.description: Save the selected factory's current build queue as preset 3

details.title: Saved settings
details.text: Presets are kept per factory type between matches and include the queue, repeat state and quota settings.

details.title: Delete preset
details.text: Save an empty queue to clear the slot.

shortcuts.label: Save Factory Preset
shortcuts.description: Save the factory’s current production settings in a preset slot.

details.title: Saved settings
details.text: Presets are kept per factory type between matches and include the queue, repeat state and quota settings.

details.title: Delete preset
details.text: Save an empty queue to clear the slot.

shortcuts.label: Add One by Mouse
shortcuts.description: Left-click a factory build icon to add 1 unit.

details.title: Quota mode
details.text: Adjusts the target count instead of the production queue.

shortcuts.label: Add Five by Mouse
shortcuts.description: Hold Shift and left-click a factory build icon to add 5 units.

details.title: Quota mode
details.text: Adjusts the target count instead of the production queue.

shortcuts.label: Add Twenty by Mouse
shortcuts.description: Hold Ctrl and left-click a factory build icon to add 20 units.

details.title: Quota mode
details.text: Adjusts the target count instead of the production queue.

shortcuts.label: Add One Hundred by Mouse
shortcuts.description: Hold Ctrl+Shift and left-click a factory build icon to add 100 units.

details.title: Quota mode
details.text: Adjusts the target count instead of the production queue.

shortcuts.label: Load Units
shortcuts.description: Press J, then left-click a unit to load it.

shortcuts.label: Load Units (Area)
shortcuts.description: Press J, then left-drag a circle to load units inside it.

shortcuts.label: Load All in Area
shortcuts.description: Press J, then hold Ctrl and left-drag a circle from a unit to distribute passengers across selected transports.

shortcuts.label: Load Area by Type
shortcuts.description: Press J, then hold Alt and left-drag a circle from a unit to load only that type.

shortcuts.label: Unload Units
shortcuts.description: Press U, then left-click a destination to unload passengers.

shortcuts.label: Unload Units (Area)
shortcuts.description: Press U, then left-drag a circle to unload passengers in the area.

shortcuts.label: Select Control Group 1
shortcuts.description: Select units assigned to group 1

shortcuts.label: Select Control Group 2
shortcuts.description: Select units assigned to group 2

shortcuts.label: Select Control Group 3
shortcuts.description: Select units assigned to group 3

shortcuts.label: Select Control Group
shortcuts.description: Select the units in a control group.

shortcuts.label: Assign to Control Group 1
shortcuts.description: Assign all selected units to group 1

shortcuts.label: Assign to Control Group 2
shortcuts.description: Assign all selected units to group 2

shortcuts.label: Assign to Control Group 3
shortcuts.description: Assign all selected units to group 3

shortcuts.label: Assign to Control Group
shortcuts.description: Replace current group assignment with all selected units

shortcuts.label: Add to Control Group 1
shortcuts.description: Add selected units to control group 1.

shortcuts.label: Add to Control Group 2
shortcuts.description: Add selected units to control group 2.

shortcuts.label: Add to Control Group 3
shortcuts.description: Add selected units to control group 3.

shortcuts.label: Add to Control Group
shortcuts.description: Add selected units to a control group.

shortcuts.label: Remove from Control Groups
shortcuts.description: Remove selected units from all their control groups

shortcuts.label: Add to Auto-Group 1
shortcuts.description: Assign selected unit types to an auto-group, including existing ungrouped units and future units.

shortcuts.label: Add to Auto-Group 2
shortcuts.description: Assign selected unit types to an auto-group, including existing ungrouped units and future units.

shortcuts.label: Add to Auto-Group 3
shortcuts.description: Assign selected unit types to an auto-group, including existing ungrouped units and future units.

shortcuts.label: Add to Auto-Group
shortcuts.description: Assign selected unit types to an auto-group, including existing ungrouped units and future units.

shortcuts.label: Remove from Auto-Group
shortcuts.description: Remove the unit types of selected units from their auto group configuration

shortcuts.label: Load Auto-Group Preset 1
shortcuts.description: Switch to auto group preset 1

shortcuts.label: Load Auto-Group Preset 2
shortcuts.description: Switch to auto group preset 2

shortcuts.label: Load Auto-Group Preset 3
shortcuts.description: Switch to auto group preset 3

shortcuts.label: Load Auto-Group Preset
shortcuts.description: Recall a saved autogroup configuration — preset 1 is selected automatically at match start

shortcuts.label: Add Control Group 1 to Selection
shortcuts.description: Add control group 1 to the selection.

shortcuts.label: Add Control Group 2 to Selection
shortcuts.description: Add control group 2 to the selection.

shortcuts.label: Add Control Group 3 to Selection
shortcuts.description: Add control group 3 to the selection.

shortcuts.label: Add Control Group to Selection
shortcuts.description: Add a control group to the selection.

shortcuts.label: Toggle Control Group 1 in Selection
shortcuts.description: Add group 1 to the selection, or drop it again if it is already in

shortcuts.label: Toggle Control Group 2 in Selection
shortcuts.description: Add group 2 to the selection, or drop it again if it is already in

shortcuts.label: Toggle Control Group 3 in Selection
shortcuts.description: Add group 3 to the selection, or drop it again if it is already in

shortcuts.label: Toggle Control Group in Selection
shortcuts.description: Add that group to the selection, or drop it again if it is already in

shortcuts.label: Pan the Camera
shortcuts.description: Hold the middle button and drag — the view slides with the mouse

shortcuts.label: Jump via Minimap
shortcuts.description: Left-click the minimap — the camera jumps to that spot

shortcuts.label: Jump to Camera Anchor 1
shortcuts.description: Jump to stored camera position 1

shortcuts.label: Jump to Camera Anchor 2
shortcuts.description: Jump to stored camera position 2

shortcuts.label: Set Camera Anchor 1
shortcuts.description: Save the current camera position to slot 1

shortcuts.label: Set Camera Anchor 2
shortcuts.description: Save the current camera position to slot 2

shortcuts.label: Jump to Camera Anchor
shortcuts.description: Jump to a saved camera position.

shortcuts.label: Set Camera Anchor
shortcuts.description: Save the current camera position to that slot

shortcuts.label: Map Overview
shortcuts.description: Zoom out to the whole map, then press again or click a spot to jump back in

shortcuts.label: Flip Camera
shortcuts.description: Rotate the camera 180° to look from the opposite direction

shortcuts.label: Show Passability
shortcuts.description: Toggle pathfinding debug overlay

shortcuts.label: Jump to Last Ping
shortcuts.description: Move the camera to the most recent map marker or message position

shortcuts.label: Show Metal Map
shortcuts.description: Toggle the metal map — shows every extractor spot and how rich it is

shortcuts.label: Show Height Map
shortcuts.description: Toggle the height map, so you can read ridges and valleys at a glance

shortcuts.label: Overhead Camera
shortcuts.description: Switch to the TA-style overhead camera.

shortcuts.label: Spring Camera
shortcuts.description: Switch to the Spring camera, which supports tilting and rotating.

shortcuts.label: LOS View
shortcuts.description: Toggle the line-of-sight overlay, shading everything your units cannot see

shortcuts.label: Show / Hide HUD
shortcuts.description: Hide the whole interface for a clean look at the battlefield — press again to bring it back

shortcuts.label: Attack Range: Next
shortcuts.description: With exactly one unit selected, step to the next attack-range display preset for its type.

shortcuts.label: Attack Range: Previous
shortcuts.description: With exactly one unit selected, step to the previous attack-range display preset for its type.

shortcuts.label: Field of View +
shortcuts.description: Widen the camera’s field of view by 5°.

shortcuts.label: Field of View −
shortcuts.description: Narrow the camera’s field of view by 5°.

shortcuts.label: Pan Camera Up
shortcuts.description: Move the camera with the arrow key.

shortcuts.label: Pan Camera Down
shortcuts.description: Move the camera with the arrow key.

shortcuts.label: Pan Camera Left
shortcuts.description: Move the camera with the arrow key.

shortcuts.label: Pan Camera Right
shortcuts.description: Move the camera with the arrow key.

shortcuts.label: Zoom Camera
shortcuts.description: Use the mouse wheel to zoom.

shortcuts.label: Tilt Camera
shortcuts.description: Hold Ctrl and use the mouse wheel to tilt the camera.

shortcuts.label: Rotate Spring Camera
shortcuts.description: In Spring camera mode, hold Alt and drag with the middle button to rotate and tilt.

shortcuts.label: Track Selection in PiP
shortcuts.description: Lock the picture-in-picture camera onto the units you have selected

shortcuts.label: Swap Camera and PiP
shortcuts.description: Exchange the main camera position with the PiP camera position

shortcuts.label: Copy Camera to PiP
shortcuts.description: Put the main camera's current position into the PiP

shortcuts.label: Chat
shortcuts.description: Open the chat input — Enter again sends the message

shortcuts.label: Chat: Allies ↔ Everyone
shortcuts.description: Toggle the chat target between your allies and everyone

shortcuts.label: Chat: Spectators ↔ Everyone
shortcuts.description: Toggle the chat target between spectators and everyone

shortcuts.label: Chat to Everyone
shortcuts.description: Always addresses everyone, whatever the current target is

shortcuts.label: Toggle Mute
shortcuts.description: Toggle game sound.

shortcuts.label: Decrease Volume
shortcuts.description: Turn the game sound down a step

shortcuts.label: Increase Volume
shortcuts.description: Turn the game sound up a step

shortcuts.label: Decrease Game Speed
shortcuts.description: Decrease game speed in single player, replays or with cheats enabled.

shortcuts.label: Increase Game Speed
shortcuts.description: Increase game speed in single player, replays or with cheats enabled.

shortcuts.label: Unit Stats
shortcuts.description: Hold I to show unit statistics.

shortcuts.label: Map Details
shortcuts.description: Toggle the map and game info panel

shortcuts.label: Ping the Map
shortcuts.description: Hold the drawing key and middle-click — drops a marker your allies see and hear

shortcuts.label: Place Label
shortcuts.description: Hold the drawing key and double-click — opens a text label at that spot

shortcuts.label: Draw on the Map
shortcuts.description: Hold the drawing key and drag — freehand lines for your allies

shortcuts.label: Widget Selector
shortcuts.description: Open the list of UI widgets to switch them on and off

shortcuts.label: Settings
shortcuts.description: Open the settings menu

shortcuts.label: Take Screenshot
shortcuts.description: Save a screenshot to your BAR folder

shortcuts.label: Vote Forcestart
shortcuts.description: Force the game to start as host, or request a start vote as a player.

shortcuts.label: Erase Drawings
shortcuts.description: Hold the drawing key and right-drag — wipes drawings and markers you pass over
